channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Iranian Doctor Says Medical Staff Arrested For Treating Wounded Protesters
item.description: After a wave of state violence against antigovernment protesters left thousands dead and wounded, reports have emerged of authorities raiding hospitals to arrest victims seeking treatment. One doctor said that the physicians providing care have also been arrested or threatened by security forces.

item.title: Trump Says Putin 'Agreed' To Halt Air Strikes For A Week As Freezing Weather Hits Ukraine
item.description: US President Donald Trump said he asked Russian President Vladimir Putin "not to fire into Kyiv and various towns for a week" amid freezing cold weather, as Russian forces continued to pound Ukrainian regions, killing multiple people.

item.title: Iran's Internet Blackout Is Already Showing Cracks
item.description: Iran's Internet blackout, leveled at the height of mass protests against the regime, is still largely holding -- but the state is allowing some users, such as banks and other institutions, to reconnect. Some dissidents, meanwhile, have broken through with the help of satellite technology.

item.title: Live Blog: Trump: Iran Wants To Make A Deal
item.description: Thousands of Iranians are dead or detained in a brutal crackdown after they took to the streets in what is seen as the biggest threat to the Islamic regime in years. Journalists from RFE/RL’s Iranian service, Radio Farda, bring you the latest developments, analysis, and reporting from on the ground.

item.title: Amid Specter Of Possible US Strikes, Iran's Neighbors Brace For Blowback
item.description: As the United States expands its military presence in the Middle East amid growing expectations of a strike against Iran, countries around the Middle East are bracing for another conflict in the region.

item.title: Russia Strikes Ukraine After Trump Says Putin Agreed To Week-Long Halt
item.description: Russia launched a ballistic missile and more than 100 drones at Ukraine overnight, none of which hit Kyiv, after US President Donald Trump's statement that Russian President Vladimir Putin had agreed to pause air strikes on the capital and other "various towns" until February 1.

item.title: The Tehran Street Corner Used For Iran's Combative Propaganda
item.description: An intersection in Tehran has been coopted as a vast visual propaganda platform as domestic and external crises mount for Iran's Islamic Republic.

item.title: 'Ukraine Is Not Losing, Russia Is Not Winning': Amid Push For Peace, Here's How Things Look On The Battlefield
item.description: Weeks before the start of the fifth year of its all-out war, Russia is having more success obliterating Ukraine’s energy systems than it is securing any decisive battlefield victory. Ukraine’s exhaustion hangs over the US-backed peace talks, which have progressed further than any other negotiations

item.title: Hatam Qaderi: Iran's Leaders Are Praying For A 'Miracle' As Their Grip On Power Erodes
item.description: RFE/RL spoke with Hatam Qaderi, a Tehran-based academic, about Iran’s bloody crackdown on mass protests, the prospect of US military action against Tehran, and a possible transition from the Islamic republic.

item.title: Funeral For 'Bright And Positive' Mother Killed In Russian Drone Strike Near Kyiv
item.description: Mourners gathered in Bilohorodka, west of Kyiv, for the funeral of Svitlana Chernovol, who was killed along with her partner when a drone hit their residential building. Her neighbor, an RFE/RL correspondent, had rushed to her apartment to save the victim's four-year-old daughter from the fire.
